name: March of the Black King refreshes Shadow Brand without stopping its ticks (#9865)
contract: Shadow Brand 680516 reads 'Direct ability damage now applies Shadow Brand to enemies'; its debuff 680517 'Marks
the target for $d, dealing $o2 Shadow Damage over $d' (DurationIndex 29, 12 s) with a
SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE effect every 3000 ms. March of the Black King 681217 is a 10-second caster aura that
deals its Shadow damage through 681094 every 2000 ms, and those direct hits apply Shadow Brand (spell_proc
allows triggered procs). Both tooltips promise their own damage, so while March keeps refreshing the brand
every two seconds, the brand must still tick on its three-second cadence: a refresh may extend the duration but
must not restart the tick timer, or a two-second refresh would stop every tick until March ends. Within 9.5
seconds of the first pulse the brand ticks at about 3, 6 and 9 seconds, so at least two ticks are required,
while a restarting timer would give none before March's last refresh. March's own pulses must also land:
with SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD it pulses at 0, 2, 4, 6 and 8 seconds (and 10), so at least five
hits by the end of its ten-second lifetime.

steps.label: A March pulse hits the target
The direct March hit applies Shadow Brand
Shadow Brand keeps ticking while March refreshes it every two seconds
March keeps dealing its own damage alongside the brand
